description:
What a subject's audience asks and struggles with: the top comments of its outliers
    (videos that beat their own channel; or your video_ids, or a channel's best uploads),
    grouped into questions, pain points and requests. clusters: label, kind (question,
    pain_point, request, other), count (comments in the group, counted in code, never by the
    model), likes, videos, and quotes: two real comments found word for word, each with its
    link (url opens the comment). videos: what was read, with views, multiple (views over the
    channel's usual), comments_read and comments_off. basis says what the counts are from.
    Costs 3 credits, refunded when the read fails; a request naming nothing or two things is
    422 and costs nothing. Takes about 60 to 100 seconds (measured 2026-10-26). Same as POST
    /v1/comments/insights. Read it back with get_call.

channel.description: a YouTube @handle or channel link: its uploads that beat its usual views
channel.title: Channel

idempotency_key.description: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters; the same key and request within 24 hours answer the saved remix and charge nothing; the same key with another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

subject.description: what the videos are about, 3 to 120 characters: its outliers are read. Send this, video_ids or channel
subject.title: Subject

video_ids.description: 1 to 8 YouTube video ids or links whose comments to read
video_ids.title: Video Ids

name: comment_insights
